witness.branch: Authorized crossing initiated by road entry
witness.quote: When authorized to cross diagonally, pedestrians shall cross only in accordance with the official traffic-control devices pertaining to such crossing movements.
witness.reason: Road entry can initiate an expressly authorized opposite-corner crossing governed by a pertaining device.
required_context: Construct a person-afoot entry route continuing across the intersection between opposite corners.
Construct the complete accessible crossing route and synchronize path observations with every pertaining device instruction and change.
Preserve the NRS 484B.290 [LVMC-11-30-140-B] exception; do not infer an all-way phase requirement or a legal consequence from a phase change alone.
Supply actual diagonal authorization and the device's instructions, official-status evidence and pedestrian-specific governed movement.
Supply an actual authorization instruction, its official-status basis and its applicability to this pedestrian's crossing movement.
Verify entry-route and map support and preserve the unresolved referenced exception.
witness.subject_reason: The available pedestrian variant is instantiated as a person afoot.
